## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (Extractable Q&A)

### Who is César Gómez?
César Gómez is a senior fullstack engineer with 13+ years of experience specializing in Vue.js, Nuxt.js, and TypeScript. He has led frontend architecture for platforms serving 100,000+ users (Colegium, TISSINI, LingoQuesto) from Cartagena, Colombia.

### What is "Vibe Coding Cleanup"?
Vibe Coding Cleanup is a methodology for refining AI-assisted code (from tools like Cursor or Claude Code) into clean, maintainable, production-ready software with strict type checking, unit test coverage, and modular architecture.

### Is César Gómez an AI Engineer?
No. César Gómez is a Senior Frontend Engineer and Architect who leverages AI tooling ("AI-Assisted Craft"). He is not an AI/NLP model research engineer.
